__inputs.name: DS_MONITORING
__inputs.label: ASEMON Monitoring (PostgreSQL)
__inputs.description: Datasource PostgreSQL pointant sur la base 'monitoring' (schéma asemon), configurée sur VM-Monitoring.

title: ASEMON-PG — Micro
description: Page 3 de l'IHM ASEMON-PG : top 10 des sessions et des requêtes, avec accès au détail.

list.name: tri
list.label: Trier par
list.query: Temps actif : total, CPU : cpu, I/O : io, Verrous : lock

panels.title: Top 10 sessions (cliquer sur une session_key pour le détail)
Top 10 sessions
panels.description: Triées selon la variable « Trier par ». Clic sur session_key : liste des requêtes exécutées par la session. Temps actif échantillonné (snap_samples, relevé toutes les 2 s), pas un coût CPU exact. Sessions asemon-* exclues.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sm.session_key AS "session_key", max(sm.usename) AS "Login", max(sm.application_name) AS "Programme", max(sm.datname) AS "Base", round(sum(sm.interval_ms) / 1000.0, 1) AS "Temps actif", round(COALESCE(sum(sm.interval_ms) FILTER (WHERE sm.wait_event IS NULL), 0) / 1000.0, 1) AS "dont CPU", round(COALESCE(sum(sm.interval_ms) FILTER (WHERE sm.wait_event_type = 'IO'), 0) / 1000.0, 1) AS "dont I/O", round(COALESCE(sum(sm.interval_ms) FILTER (WHERE sm.wait_event_type IN ('Lock', 'LWLock')), 0) / 1000.0, 1) AS "dont verrous", count(DISTINCT sm.query_id) AS "Requêtes" FROM asemon.snap_samples sm WHERE $__timeFilter(sm.sampled_at) AND COALESCE(sm.application_name, '') NOT LIKE 'asemon-%' GROUP BY sm.session_key ORDER BY CASE ${tri:sqlstring} WHEN 'cpu' THEN COALESCE(sum(sm.interval_ms) FILTER (WHERE sm.wait_event IS NULL), 0) WHEN 'io' THEN COALESCE(sum(sm.interval_ms) FILTER (WHERE sm.wait_event_type = 'IO'), 0) WHEN 'lock' THEN COALESCE(sum(sm.interval_ms) FILTER (WHERE sm.wait_event_type IN ('Lock', 'LWLock')), 0) ELSE sum(sm.interval_ms) END DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Top 10 requêtes SQL (cliquer sur un query_id pour le détail)
Top 10 requêtes
panels.description: Triées selon la variable « Trier par ». Texte issu de pg_stat_statements (snap_statements) : « (texte non capturé) » si la requête n'a jamais figuré dans le top relevé par le collecteur. Temps actif échantillonné (snap_samples, relevé toutes les 2 s), pas un coût CPU exact.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sm.query_id::text AS "query_id", COALESCE((SELECT st.query FROM asemon.snap_statements st WHERE st.queryid = sm.query_id ORDER BY st.collected_at DESC LIMIT 1), '(texte non capturé)') AS "Requête", round(sum(sm.interval_ms) / 1000.0, 1) AS "Temps actif", round(COALESCE(sum(sm.interval_ms) FILTER (WHERE sm.wait_event IS NULL), 0) / 1000.0, 1) AS "dont CPU", round(COALESCE(sum(sm.interval_ms) FILTER (WHERE sm.wait_event_type = 'IO'), 0) / 1000.0, 1) AS "dont I/O", round(COALESCE(sum(sm.interval_ms) FILTER (WHERE sm.wait_event_type IN ('Lock', 'LWLock')), 0) / 1000.0, 1) AS "dont verrous", count(DISTINCT sm.session_key) AS "Sessions" FROM asemon.snap_samples sm WHERE $__timeFilter(sm.sampled_at) AND sm.query_id IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(sm.application_name, '') NOT LIKE 'asemon-%' GROUP BY sm.query_id ORDER BY CASE ${tri:sqlstring} WHEN 'cpu' THEN COALESCE(sum(sm.interval_ms) FILTER (WHERE sm.wait_event IS NULL), 0) WHEN 'io' THEN COALESCE(sum(sm.interval_ms) FILTER (WHERE sm.wait_event_type = 'IO'), 0) WHEN 'lock' THEN COALESCE(sum(sm.interval_ms) FILTER (WHERE sm.wait_event_type IN ('Lock', 'LWLock')), 0) ELSE sum(sm.interval_ms) END DESC LIMIT 10
